gloss_en: "the one who makes peace" (ha-oseh shalom, הָעוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם) — the liturgical/scriptural epithet for the peacemaker, invoked in Likutey Moharan I:75 as the aspect of resolving dispute (e.g., a teirutz reconciling contradictory ideas), identified with the elevation of mayin nukvin; not the abstract noun 'peace' itself
